title.narrative: NPA Programme Iraq 2019-2023 - NPA Country Programme Iraq (New Strategy)

description.narrative: Insatsen avser stöd till NPA (Norwegian People's Aid) som skall stödja ett antal civilsamhällesorganisationer i Irak för att öka deras förmåga att mobilisera människor och ge dem möjlighet att delta i samhällsutvecklingen. Syftet med stödet är att stärka organisationerna att föra kvinnors och ungdomars talan, och hålla regeringens institutioner ansvariga för bristande utveckling. NPA ser insatsen som en sätt att öka det demokratiska utrymmet i Irak, vilket man hävdar är krympande. De tre målen för insatsen avser ökat deltagande av kvinnor och ungdomar i det offentliga beslutsfattandet och öka civila samhällets påverkan på politiska beslut.

Support to NPA (Norwegian People's Aid), which in their turn will support a number of civil society organizations in Iraq to increase their ability to mobilize people and give them the opportunity to participate in social development. The purpose of the support is to strengthen the organizations to make women and young people to take part in the development of the society, and to hold the government's institutions responsible for lack of development. The NPA sees this as a way to increase democratic space in Iraq, which is shrinking. The three contribution objectives are aimed at increasing the participation of women and young people in public decision-making and to increase the impact of civil society on political decisions.

The aim of the contribution has been to strengthen the capacity of civil society actors in Iraq to better protect the rights of all citizens, especially those whose voice in decisionmaking is rarely heard such as women and young people.
The expected outcomes were: 1. Women influence and participate in decision-.making 2. Youth have representation to influence decision-making 3. Strengthened civil society organizations effectively influence decisions, promote rights and freedoms and empower their constituencies and communities.
